name: Stalker Claws
summary: Across Mulgore, Stalker Claws are taken from prairie stalkers for a cleansing rite. Tauren shamans bind them into totems used to purify tainted wells.

sections.title: Predators of the Plains
sections.body: Prairie stalkers hunt across Mulgore’s grassy steppes. Their stealth and lethal precision make them deadly predators, yet they keep an essential balance within the Earth Mother's design. Mull Thunderhorn needs their claws to help heal the blighted land. He seeks no harm to the beasts; the natural force of their hunt holds the spiritual strength needed to counter artificial corruption.

sections.title: Cleansing the Wells
sections.body: Goblin drilling and mining across central Kalimdor have sent chemical poisons into the underground waters that feed ancestral tauren wells. The Thunderhorn Water Well has been tainted by vile muck. Tribal shamans bind Stalker Claws and Cougar Claws into a Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem, a spiritual conduit that scours the unnatural sludge from the earth's springs.

faq.q: Where do Stalker Claws come from?
faq.answer: Prairie stalkers roam the grassy hills of Mulgore, especially east and west of Bloodhoof Village. Their claws are gathered by hunting them.

faq.q: Why does Mull Thunderhorn need these claws?
faq.answer: Mull Thunderhorn needs the claws, along with flatland cougar claws, to make a Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem. The native hunters' purity and strength help purify the poisoned wells.

faq.q: Why is the Thunderhorn Water Well tainted?
faq.answer: Goblin operations in Mulgore cause unnatural industrial pollution. Their work disrupts the natural balance and poisons the local water table.

faq.q: What happens after the claws are gathered?
faq.answer: After the claws are gathered, Mull carves them into a cleansing totem. The totem must then be carried directly to the Thunderhorn Water Well to purge its lingering corruption.

angles.text: As a tauren, gathering these claws helps your tribe restore its sacred waters, poisoned by careless industrial trespassers.
As a shaman, you bind the fierce purity of wild plains predators into cleansing totems. Their claws are essential to empower the totems.
